settings.knowledgeHint: When off, the agent answers from the model's own knowledge (and the web, if enabled).
settings.librariesHint: The agent searches only these libraries, within what it can access. Library names are in the Knowledge section.
settings.webHint: When on, the agent may also search the public web. KANAP knowledge always takes precedence, and web results are cited in replies.
settings.webUnavailableHint: Web search isn't available on this platform yet. Contact your administrator to enable it.

autonomyDialog.title: Enable automatic {{actionClass}}?
autonomyDialog.evidence: Based on {{decided}} decisions with {{rate}} acceptance over {{days}} days.
autonomyDialog.frame: Automatic actions still respect the daily limits and emergency pause, and return to ask-first if acceptance drops.
autonomyDialog.overrideFrame: This override bypasses recommendation thresholds only. Hard safety limits, freshness checks, provider support, budgets, pauses, and public-reply restrictions still apply.
autonomyDialog.highRiskGeneric: This action is visible outside your team or moves work between people. Turning it on means the agent does it without anyone reviewing it first.

highRisk.public_reply: The agent will reply to requesters directly, with nobody reading the reply first. Turn this on only if you are comfortable with what it has proposed so far.
highRisk.assignment: The agent will reassign tickets to other people, with nobody reviewing the change first.
highRisk.participant: The agent will add and remove people on tickets, with nobody reviewing the change first.

autonomyDialog.reasonHighRiskHint: Required. It is kept in the agent history so your team can see who accepted this and why.

autonomyReasons.CAPABILITY_NOT_ALLOWED: This action isn't enabled for this agent.
autonomyReasons.ACCEPTANCE_RATE_TOO_LOW: Acceptance rate is below the threshold.
autonomyReasons.OBSERVATION_WINDOW_TOO_SHORT: Not enough days of activity yet.
autonomyReasons.OPEN_INCIDENT_FLAG: An open incident is blocking automation.
autonomyReasons.HIGH_RISK_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_REQUIRED: This action needs an explicit acknowledgement and a reason.

settings.maxMonitoringRequests: Requests to the monitoring tool per check
settings.monitoringNotConnected: No monitoring tool connected — this agent cannot run.
settings.kanapDataHint: Let the agent look up your own IT inventory to add business context to a diagnosis.
settings.modelListError: The model list could not be loaded, so the choices shown may be incomplete.
settings.activityRetentionHint: How long this agent's timeline is kept. Older entries are deleted automatically (7 to 90 days). Keep at least 30 days if you plan to turn on automatic mode: the agent's track record is measured over the last 28 days.
settings.safetyLimitsInfo: Hard stops, not estimates. When the agent reaches one of these limits it stops working for the rest of the day and waits for you.
settings.checkIntervalInfo: How often the agent looks for new tickets while it is watching. Between 5 minutes and 24 hours. "Check now" always runs straight away, whatever this says.
settings.checkIntervalAlertsInfo: How often the agent looks for new alerts while it is watching. Between 5 minutes and 24 hours. "Check for new alerts" always runs straight away, whatever this says.
settings.purposeInfo: What this agent is here to do, in one line. It reads this on every run.
settings.instructionsInfo: House rules the agent follows — write them freely, as lines or paragraphs. They cannot widen what the agent is allowed to do.
settings.replyLanguageInfo: The language the agent writes in. "Ticket language" makes it answer in whatever language the requester used.
settings.capabilitiesInfo: What this agent may prepare. Everything switched off here is never proposed, whatever the instructions say.

reference.title: Names you can use in the instructions
reference.insertHint: Click a name to insert it in the instructions.
reference.groupsEmpty: The ticketing system exposes no assignable group.
reference.groupsDisabled: Enable Assignment in Capabilities to let the agent route tickets to a group.
reference.techniciansEmpty: The ticketing system exposes no technician in an assignable group.
reference.classificationDisabled: Enable Classification in Capabilities to let the instructions guide category, priority and type.
reference.categoriesScope: Search covers every category. With a very large catalogue, the agent works from the categories you target first.
reference.catalogueError: The catalogue could not be loaded.

settings.modelInfo: Which AI model this agent runs on. Models are managed in Administration under AI models.
settings.maxTicketsInfo: The most tickets the agent picks up in a single check. The rest wait for the next one.
settings.maxRequestsInfo: The most calls the agent makes to the ticketing system in a single check, so it never floods it.
settings.maxAlertsInfo: The most alerts the agent diagnoses in a single check. The rest wait for the next one.
settings.maxMonitoringRequestsInfo: The most calls the agent makes to the monitoring tool in a single check, so it never floods it.
settings.reviewCooldownInfo: How soon the agent may look at the same ticket again after there is nothing waiting. A waiting proposal is not replaced until it expires, you decide, or the ticket changes.
settings.agentPriorityInfo: Which agent wins when several of them target the same ticket. The lower the number, the higher the priority.
settings.onConflictInfo: What the agent does when another agent is already working on the same ticket: stand back, or take over from an agent of equal priority.
settings.onStaleInfo: What happens to a waiting proposal when the ticket changes before you decide: look at it again, drop it, or apply it as it is.
settings.ticketActorRoleInfo: How the agent appears among the ticket actors after it writes on a ticket. Taking the ticket marks it as assigned to the agent's GLPI user. Internal notes never assign; they add the agent as an observer at most.
settings.perRunTokensInfo: The most words the agent may spend on one ticket. Reaching it stops that ticket and nothing is proposed for it.
settings.perRunCostInfo: The most the agent may spend on one ticket, estimated from the assigned model’s prices. A free model (0 EUR) never reaches it, so the word limit stays the real protection.
settings.dailyRunsInfo: Stop the agent for the day once it has worked on this many tickets. It starts again the next day.
settings.dailyTokensInfo: Stop the agent for the day once it has spent this many words. It starts again the next day.
settings.dailyCostInfo: Stop the agent for the day once it has cost this much, estimated from the assigned model’s prices. It starts again the next day.
settings.autonomyHighRisk: The requester sees this, or the work moves to someone else.

autonomyHighRiskNote.public_reply: The agent would reply to the requester with nobody reading it first.
autonomyHighRiskNote.assignment: The agent would reassign tickets with nobody reading it first.
autonomyHighRiskNote.participant: The agent would add or remove people on tickets with nobody reading it first.

settings.instructionsOverLimit: Instructions are limited to {{max}} characters. Beyond that, part of them would no longer reach the agent. This section is not saved while it is over the limit.
settings.personaBlockedSave: Changes not saved: Purpose or Instructions is over its limit. Shorten the text to resume saving.
settings.sharedContextTruncated: {{count}} shared-context lines reach the model shortened (500-character limit per line).
settings.promptCostHint: Instructions and shared context use about {{tokens}} tokens of each step’s budget ({{cap}} per run).

actions.dismissHint: Set aside without counting against the agent's track record
